### they/them

\

Hello!

I am a master's student at KU Leuven in the Psychology: Theory and Research program. My thesis aims to validate a post-stroke cognitive assessment that has been adapted for use in fMRI. I am also working on an internship with the psychology department here at KU Leuven, which focuses on decision making processes in numerosity utilizing EEG and computational modelling. 

Next, I aim to pursue a PhD in Cognitive Neuroscience. I hope to continue using neuroimaging methods to investigate problems with real world impact, including numerosity, language, and exercise. 

Outside of the classroom, I can often be found outdoors hiking and swimming. I am an avid reader and enjoy different hobbies from baking to printmaking - any art found on this site was made by me.
